answer: Require each agent to stake a refundable deposit before it can transact, and tie reputation to a single verifiable identity thread rather than free accounts. A newcomer starts dim, like an unlit lantern: it can observe but earns no trust until it completes paid, checkable work over time. Creating a thousand fake identities then costs a thousand deposits plus a thousand histories, while honest agents keep their stake. The nebula of anonymous accounts collapses into accountable participants, because sybils become expensive and traceable instead of free.
